items.text: David Montgomery (groin) removed from injury report after full practices; expected to play Thursday vs IND. Woody Marks (concussion) OUT.
items.why: Full practices all week, no designation
items.implication: Lead RB role vs weak Colts; RB2 restart

items.text: Andy Reid on Kenneth Walker (groin): sore, getting better, but 'don't want to do something stupid.' Levitan agrees sitting him at less than 100% is smart given Chiefs 15.5-pt favorites vs ARI and huge @BUF Week 12. DNP Wednesday.
items.why: Reid caution + schedule; Emmett Johnson just thrived
items.implication: High risk of another sit; fade Walker if GTD
items.opportunity: Backup RB (Emmett Johnson) smash if OUT

items.text: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday due to a foot injury. Trending toward possible miss vs DET; rookie could start.
items.implication: Bucs QB uncertainty; monitor for sit

items.text: FULL CHUB(A) FOR MR. HUBBARD! Chuba Hubbard is Berry's RB6 in rest-of-season rankings.
No IR for Jordan Addison per coach Kevin O’Connell (thumb surgery, multiple weeks but not IR).
Drake Maye ankle injury (possible fracture) potentially season-ending after Munich loss; NE hard negatives post-Maye.
items.implication: NE offense collapse; fade remaining pieces

items.text: In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set season-high Pass Rate Over Expectation. Clear Kevin O'Connell wants to throw a lot; boosts Jefferson routes/opportunity.
Brock Bowers (ankle) DNP Wednesday, day-to-day per coach; significant but not as bad as feared. Could play without practice vs DEN.
items.why: Ankle rolled Week 10; progressing but DNP
items.implication: Do not lock in lineups yet; backup plan needed

items.text: Week 11 Snaps & Pace: TEN @ DAL up in pace (Titans no-huddle surge + Dallas volume). MIA @ BUF slow slog.
items.implication: Higher play volume for TEN/DAL skill players
items.opportunity: Pace boost for Pollard, Lamb, etc.

items.text: Berry closing it out on Jalen Coker: talent there but fantasy production has not been.
The Jonathan Brooks slappies have a mental illness, it's legit scary. Dunk on Brooks hype.
Matthew Berry is CLOSING IT OUT on Jaylen Waddle. Target share nice but fantasy production is not.
Lions placed EDGE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve; activated S Kerby Joseph from PUP.
ETR has Jonathan Taylor ahead of Chase Brown in the ROS Top-150 half-PPR. In full-PPR, Brown further ahead.
items.implication: JT preferred half-PPR ROS over Brown
